title: The release journal of one production host (t-2026-10-12-30)
description: Written by deploy/auto/release-agent.sh at /var/lib/upready-store-release/journal.json on the host; one record per release, in the order they started. Checked by deploy/auto/journal-check.mjs.

host.description: the host name of the machine the agent runs on

kind.description: adopted: the sha that was live when install.sh ran, recorded without a release

step.description: the step a failure ended in: 0 prepare (GitHub, the tarball), 1 to 7 the steps of deploy-instance.sh

reason.description: why it failed, or what a success had to forgive (known reds)

log.description: the folder on the host with baseline.out, release.out and the deploy-instance.sh log

checks_run.description: the pr-checks.yml run whose required jobs were green

after.description: what allowed the start: required checks green (INTL), release/intl = success (RU)

switch.description: the switch as read when the release started

new_reds.description: checks red after the release, not before it and not back within the grace

published.description: the commit status release/<instance> of the end of this record is on GitHub
